description: What reaches end-of-life soon. Returns every tracked version whose EOL date falls within the next N days (default 90), optionally limited to a list of products, sorted by date. Also lists versions that went EOL within the last "recent_past_days" days when set. Use for "what in our stack expires this quarter?".

products.description: Optional product slugs or names to restrict to (max 50). Omit for the whole catalog.

recent_past_days.description: Also include versions that went EOL within this many days in the past (default 0).

name: get_upcoming_eol
title: Upcoming end-of-life calendar
